tolerance: EXACT after half-up rounding to one decimal. Not a tolerance band: these three numbers are published to the tenth, so anything short of agreement to the tenth means the reimplementation differs and the difference has not been explained.
baseline: Baseball-Reference published career WAR, WAR7 and JAWS, transcribed into REPRODUCTION_TARGETS
what_this_does_not_show: agreement on the benchmark shelf, and nothing about whether the shelf predicts induction. It is a correctness check on a reimplementation, not evidence for any Hall of Fame claim.
